app.name: CubiisOnline
app.long_description: CubiisOnline is a multiplayer platformer for the Wii. Enter your name on the built-in keyboard, pick a colour, choose one of 6 servers, then jump around with up to 8 players. Run game-server.js on a PC on the same WiFi, enter its IP in the app, and play together in real time. D-Pad to move, A to jump, B to disconnect, HOME to quit.
